The Penny Shirt is a relaxed-fitting camp shirt. Featuring chest flap patch pockets, it draws inspiration from vintage camp shirts while remaining understated and versatile. Made in a brushed cotton and merino wool fabric with a soft hand and added warmth, resulting in an easy layering piece.
Details
80% cotton, 20% merino wool , woven in Portugal
• Troca shell buttons
• Made in Portugal
Care
Wash on cold and air dry.

Description
The Rib Pocket T-Shirt is crafted from a custom-developed jersey using long-staple, dual ring-spun, and combed cotton yarn. Its drop needle construction creates a ribbed texture, while the high-quality yarn ensures softness and durability. The mounted collar construction pays homage to classic sportswear tees.
Details
• 100% cotton, 6 oz. jersey
• Made in Portugal
Care
Wash on cold and tumble dry low.
